district_name: Southwest Vermont Union Elementary School District

jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603 inventory: Southwest Vermont Union Elementary School District, a union elementary district in the Southwest Vermont Supervisory Union (member towns: Bennington, Pownal, Shaftsbury, Woodford), created by the State Board's Act 46 statewide plan (Articles issued Nov. 30, 2018; operational July 1, 2019). Operates PK-6.

board.org_name: Southwest Vermont Union Elementary School Board
board.post_note: SVUESD: eight directors, residency allocated two per member town (Bennington, Pownal, Shaftsbury, Woodford), elected by the voters of the entire district (modified at-large, Articles of Agreement Arts. 10-11).

sources.note: SVSU "Current School Boards" page (official; read from page HTML -- the member lists do not survive rendered-text extraction): SVUESD board with published term expiries -- Foster 2028 (Pownal), Thurber 2029 (Woodford), Leake 2028 (Shaftsbury), Brownell 2029 (Pownal), Senecal 2027, Levin 2027, Murphy 2027 (Bennington), Karis 2029 (Bennington). The Articles of Agreement (SBE final order, Nov. 30, 2018), Arts. 10-11: eight directors, two seats allocated to each member town, elected "by a vote of the electorate of the entire New Union District" with comingled results -- modified at-large. Senecal's and Levin's towns are unpublished (by the 2-per-town arithmetic they hold the remaining Shaftsbury and Woodford seats, unattributed). Karis: the March 3, 2026 return records no candidate for the warned Bennington seat; the seat was put to the voters at the April 14, 2026 special meeting, where write-in William Karis received 124 votes and "was declared elected" in the official tally -- a write-in winner NAMED in the official tally is a certified outcome.

directors.name: Glenn Thurber
directors.note: Woodford seat; Vice-Chair. Same person as the Mount Anthony Union HSD director record (the Woodford seat on both union boards). Elected March 3, 2026 (certified return: 1,467 votes, unopposed).

directors.name: Jeff Leake
directors.note: Shaftsbury seat; Board Clerk (officer role not modeled).

directors.name: Cindy Brownell
directors.note: Pownal seat. Same person as the Pownal justice of the peace record. Declared elected in the March 3, 2026 certified return.

directors.name: William Karis
directors.note: Bennington seat. Write-in winner NAMED and declared elected in the certified April 14, 2026 special-election tally (124 votes) for the seat that drew no candidate on March 3.
